name: rosetta-ethiopian-multiplication

use default

use ROW = (multiplier: int, total: int)

halve(value: int) -> int => value / 2

double(value: int) -> int => value * 2

is_even(value: int) -> bool => value % 2 == 0

ethiopian(left: int, right: int) -> int =>
    stream((multiplier = left, total = right), (row: ROW) =>
            row || (multiplier = halve(row.multiplier),
                    total = double(row.total)))
        |> take_while(row => row.multiplier > 0)
        |> filter(row => !is_even(row.multiplier))
        |> reduce(0, (sum, row) => sum + row.total)

write_line("17 x 34 = {ethiopian(17, 34)}")
